description: Assign RGBA pixels to supplied colors, using nearby confident color matches to resolve antialiased edges. Prepare a paid HTTP request (0.05 USDC on Base). This MCP tool does not perform analysis, sign or charge. Returns the canonical endpoint, supplied input and payment instructions. Up to 128 × 128 pixels, 24 colors and 6 pixels of radius. Returns zero-based indices and null for transparent pixels.

radius.description: 0 uses nearest-color assignment without edge refinement.
